_comment: Single source for all game assets. Swap paths here to reskin. null = missing asset -> placeholder (text glyph / silence / system font).
_animComment: See README 'Animation manifest (td-pack-3)'. Missing state (null) -> procedural fallback.

ui._comment: td-pack-2/ui/mobile 9-slice art (margins from td-pack-2 ui/make_mobile.py). slice = [top,right,bottom,left] in 1x px; @2x/@3x picked by devicePixelRatio. src may contain {state}.
ui._hud2: td-pack-2/ui/hud2 (TD-9a). slice [t,r,b,l] copied from hud2/nine_slice.json (1x px).

ribbonBoss._note: TD-11c boss banner ('Final wave!' + troll intro); slice from hud2/nine_slice.json

terrain._comment: td-terrain "Storybook Meadow" kit (public/assets/terrain). Swap art by editing image keys; rules per README-td-terrain.md.

imageScales._comment: TD-11c: images with @2x/@3x variants; loader picks by devicePixelRatio (same rule as ui.scales). Anim frame size is derived from the loaded sheet; drawSize = world px.
